faq.q: How do I calculate what X percent of Y is?
faq.a: Multiply Y by X and divide by 100. For example, 20% of 50 is (20 × 50) / 100 = 10. The calculator does this for you instantly.

faq.q: How do I calculate percentage increase?
faq.a: Subtract the original value from the new value, divide by the original value, and multiply by 100. Increase from 80 to 100 is (100 − 80) / 80 × 100 = 25%.
